```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(CMAverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(fastDummies)
library(ranger)
```

```{r cleaning-pipeline}
df <- read.csv("master_data_2020.csv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(presvote20post))

treatment <- "untrustworthy_flag"
mediator  <- "encountered_fakenews1_post"

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    voted_biden_2020    = as.integer(trimws(as.character(presvote20post)) == "Joe Biden"),
    voted_trump_2020    = as.integer(trimws(as.character(presvote20post)) == "Donald Trump"),
    turnout_2020_binary = as.integer(
      !grepl("did not vote|skipped|__na__", trimws(as.character(presvote20post)), ignore.case = TRUE)
    )
  )

# Digital literacy index: average of the first numeric token in each tf_* item
tf_cols <- c("tf_adv", "tf_pdf", "tf_spy", "tf_wiki", "tf_cache", "tf_phishing")
parse_tf <- function(x) {
  first_word <- sub("\\s.*", "", trimws(as.character(x)))
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ifelse(grepl("^\\d+$", first_word), first_word, NA_real_)))
}
df$digital_literacy_index <- rowMeans(sapply(df[tf_cols], parse_tf), na.rm = TRUE)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    ideo5_linear = case_when(
      ideo5 == "Very liberal"      ~ 1L,
      ideo5 == "Liberal"           ~ 2L,
      ideo5 == "Moderate"          ~ 3L,
      ideo5 == "Conservative"      ~ 4L,
      ideo5 == "Very conservative" ~ 5L
    ),
    pid7_linear = case_when(
      pid7 == "Strong Democrat"            ~ 1L,
      pid7 == "Not very strong Democrat"   ~ 2L,
      pid7 == "Lean Democrat"              ~ 3L,
      pid7 == "Independent"                ~ 4L,
      pid7 == "Lean Republican"            ~ 5L,
      pid7 == "Not very strong Republican" ~ 6L,
      pid7 == "Strong Republican"          ~ 7L
    ),
    socmed_use_linear = case_when(
      trimws(as.character(socmed_use)) == "Less than 10 minutes per day" ~ 1L,
      trimws(as.character(socmed_use)) == "10–30 minutes per day"        ~ 2L,
      trimws(as.character(socmed_use)) == "31–60 minutes per day"        ~ 3L,
      trimws(as.character(socmed_use)) == "1–2 hours per day"            ~ 4L,
      trimws(as.character(socmed_use)) == "2–3 hours per day"            ~ 5L,
      trimws(as.character(socmed_use)) == "More than 3 hours per day"    ~ 6L
    ),
    newsint_linear = case_when(
      trimws(as.character(newsint)) == "Hardly at all"     ~ 1L,
      trimws(as.character(newsint)) == "Only now and then" ~ 2L,
      trimws(as.character(newsint)) == "Some of the time"  ~ 3L,
      trimws(as.character(newsint)) == "Most of the time"  ~ 4L
    ),
    intuse_linear = case_when(
      trimws(as.character(intuse)) == "Less often"          ~ 1L,
      trimws(as.character(intuse)) == "A few times a week"  ~ 2L,
      trimws(as.character(intuse)) == "About once a day"    ~ 3L,
      trimws(as.character(intuse)) == "Several times a day" ~ 4L,
      TRUE                                                  ~ 3L
    ),
    presvote16post_condensed = case_when(
      trimws(as.character(presvote16post)) == "Hillary Clinton" ~ "Hillary Clinton",
      trimws(as.character(presvote16post)) == "Donald Trump"    ~ "Donald Trump",
      is.na(presvote16post) |
        trimws(as.character(presvote16post)) %in%
          c("__NA__", "nan", "Did not vote", "Did not vote for President") ~ "Did Not Vote",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

core_cols              <- c(treatment, mediator, "turnout_2020_binary",
                            "voted_biden_2020", "voted_trump_2020", "age", "female")
engineered_continuous  <- "digital_literacy_index"
linear_features        <- c("ideo5_linear", "pid7_linear", "socmed_use_linear",
                            "newsint_linear", "intuse_linear")
categorical_covariates <- c("race4", "educ4", "region", "presvote16post_condensed")
all_cols               <- c(core_cols, engineered_continuous, linear_features, categorical_covariates)

df$survey_weight_raw <- ifelse(is.na(df$weight_post), 1.0, df$weight_post)

df_clean <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(all_cols), survey_weight_raw) %>%
  drop_na(all_of(all_cols))

X_matrix <- df_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(age, female, all_of(engineered_continuous),
                all_of(linear_features), all_of(categorical_covariates)) %>%
  dummy_cols(select_columns = categorical_covariates, remove_selected_columns = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("presvote16post_condensed_Donald Trump", "race4_White",
                          "educ4_College grad", "region_Midwest")))

W         <- as.integer(df_clean[[treatment]])
M         <- df_clean[[mediator]]
Y_turnout <- as.integer(df_clean[["turnout_2020_binary"]])
Y_biden   <- as.integer(df_clean[["voted_biden_2020"]])
Y_trump   <- as.integer(df_clean[["voted_trump_2020"]])
```

---

### Mediation Analysis (Unweighted)

```{r mediation-prep}
df_med <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(race4, educ4, region, presvote16post_condensed), as.factor),
    untrustworthy_flag = as.integer(untrustworthy_flag),
    encountered_fakenews1_post = case_when(
      encountered_fakenews1_post == "I have not encountered any fake news" ~ 0L,
      encountered_fakenews1_post == "Not very much"                        ~ 1L,
      encountered_fakenews1_post == "A fair amount"                        ~ 2L,
      encountered_fakenews1_post == "A great deal"                         ~ 3L,
      encountered_fakenews1_post == "Nearly all news I see is fake"        ~ 4L
    )
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

sw_q <- quantile(df_med$survey_weight_raw, c(0.05, 0.95))
sw   <- pmin(pmax(df_med$survey_weight_raw, sw_q[1]), sw_q[2])
df_med$survey_weight <- sw / mean(sw)

basec_vars <- c("age", "female", "digital_literacy_index",
                "ideo5_linear", "pid7_linear", "socmed_use_linear",
                "newsint_linear", "intuse_linear",
                "race4", "educ4", "region", "presvote16post_condensed")
```

```{r run-mediation, cache=TRUE}
NBOOT <- 1000

cmest_rb <- function(outcome) {
  cmest(
    data = df_med, model = "rb", outcome = outcome,
    exposure = "untrustworthy_flag", mediator = "encountered_fakenews1_post",
    basec = basec_vars, EMint = TRUE, mreg = list("linear"), yreg = "linear",
    astar = 0, a = 1, mval = list(mean(df_med$encountered_fakenews1_post)),
    estimation = "imputation", inference = "bootstrap", nboot = NBOOT
  )
}

res_biden <- cmest_rb("voted_biden_2020")
res_trump <- cmest_rb("voted_trump_2020")
```

```{r results-tables}
extract_effects <- function(res, outcome_label) {
  keys <- c("te", "pnde", "tnde", "pnie", "tnie")
  data.frame(
    outcome  = outcome_label,
    effect   = c("TE", "PNDE", "TNDE", "PNIE", "TNIE"),
    estimate = res$effect.pe[keys],
    ci_lower = res$effect.ci.low[keys],
    ci_upper = res$effect.ci.high[keys],
    pvalue   = res$effect.pval[keys],
    row.names = NULL, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

all_results <- bind_rows(
  extract_effects(res_biden, "Voted Biden"),
  extract_effects(res_trump, "Voted Trump")
) %>%
  mutate(
    effect_category = case_when(
      effect == "TE"                ~ "Total Effect",
      effect %in% c("PNDE", "TNDE") ~ "Natural Direct Effect",
      effect %in% c("PNIE", "TNIE") ~ "Natural Indirect Effect"
    ),
    significant = pvalue < 0.05
  )

all_results %>%
  mutate(CI = sprintf("(%.3f, %.3f)", ci_lower, ci_upper),
         estimate = round(estimate, 4), pvalue = round(pvalue, 4),
         sig = ifelse(significant, "*", "")) %>%
  dplyr::select(outcome, effect, estimate, CI, pvalue, sig)
```

```{r forest-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
effect_colors <- c("Total Effect" = "gray50",
                   "Natural Direct Effect" = "#0072B2",
                   "Natural Indirect Effect" = "#009E73")

plot_data <- all_results %>%
  mutate(
    effect          = factor(effect, levels = c("TE", "PNDE", "TNDE", "PNIE", "TNIE")),
    effect_category = factor(effect_category,
                             levels = c("Total Effect", "Natural Direct Effect", "Natural Indirect Effect")),
    outcome         = factor(outcome, levels = c("Voted Biden", "Voted Trump")),
    shape_type      = ifelse(significant, 16, 1)
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = estimate, y = effect, color = effect_category, shape = as.factor(shape_type))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lower, xmax = ci_upper), height = 0.25, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = effect_colors, name = "Effect Type") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("1" = 1, "16" = 16),
                     labels = c("1" = "Non-significant", "16" = "p < 0.05"), name = "Significance") +
  labs(x = "Effect Estimate — Risk Difference Scale (95% Bootstrap CI)", y = "Effect Type",
       title = "Effect of Untrustworthy News Exposure on 2020 Vote Choice",
       subtitle = "Mediator: Encountered Fake News Post-Treatment") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical")
```

### Survey-Weighted Mediation Analysis

```{r weighted-mediation, cache=TRUE}
NBOOT_RF <- 200
RF_NTREE <- 300
M_LEVELS <- as.character(0:4)

align_cols <- function(pmat, levels) {
  out <- matrix(0, nrow(pmat), length(levels), dimnames = list(NULL, levels))
  common <- intersect(colnames(pmat), levels)
  out[, common] <- pmat[, common, drop = FALSE]
  out
}

# Cross-fitted RF g-computation
rf_gcomp_effects <- function(data, outcome, nfold = 5, nt = RF_NTREE, seed = 1) {
  n <- nrow(data); w <- data$survey_weight
  Mf <- factor(data$encountered_fakenews1_post, levels = 0:4)
  Yf <- factor(data[[outcome]], levels = 0:1)
  set.seed(seed); fold <- sample(rep(1:nfold, length.out = n))
  Cdat <- data[, basec_vars]

  phi <- list("0" = list("0" = numeric(n), "1" = numeric(n)),
              "1" = list("0" = numeric(n), "1" = numeric(n)))

  for (k in 1:nfold) {
    tr <- which(fold != k); te <- which(fold == k)
    mfit <- ranger(M ~ ., probability = TRUE, num.trees = nt, num.threads = 0, case.weights = w[tr],
                   data = data.frame(M = Mf[tr], A = data$untrustworthy_flag[tr], Cdat[tr, , drop = FALSE]))
    yfit <- ranger(Y ~ ., probability = TRUE, num.trees = nt, num.threads = 0, case.weights = w[tr],
                   data = data.frame(Y = Yf[tr], A = data$untrustworthy_flag[tr], M = Mf[tr], Cdat[tr, , drop = FALSE]))
    Cte <- Cdat[te, , drop = FALSE]
    PM <- lapply(0:1, function(astar)
      align_cols(predict(mfit, data = data.frame(A = astar, Cte))$predictions, M_LEVELS))
    names(PM) <- c("0", "1")
    MU <- lapply(0:1, function(a) {
      mu <- matrix(0, length(te), 5, dimnames = list(NULL, M_LEVELS))
      for (m in 0:4) {
        pr <- predict(yfit, data = data.frame(A = a, M = factor(m, levels = 0:4), Cte))$predictions
        if ("1" %in% colnames(pr)) mu[, as.character(m)] <- pr[, "1"]
      }
      mu
    })
    names(MU) <- c("0", "1")
    for (a in c("0", "1")) for (astar in c("0", "1"))
      phi[[a]][[astar]][te] <- rowSums(PM[[astar]] * MU[[a]])
  }

  wm  <- function(v) weighted.mean(v, w)
  p11 <- phi[["1"]][["1"]]; p10 <- phi[["1"]][["0"]]
  p01 <- phi[["0"]][["1"]]; p00 <- phi[["0"]][["0"]]
  c(TE   = wm(p11 - p00), PNDE = wm(p10 - p00), TNDE = wm(p11 - p01),
    PNIE = wm(p01 - p00), TNIE = wm(p11 - p10))
}

weighted_mediation <- function(data, outcome, outcome_label, nboot = NBOOT_RF, seed = 123) {
  est <- rf_gcomp_effects(data, outcome, seed = seed)
  n   <- nrow(data)
  set.seed(seed)
  boot_idx <- lapply(seq_len(nboot), function(b) sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE))
  bm <- matrix(NA_real_, nboot, length(est))
  for (b in seq_len(nboot)) {
    bm[b, ] <- tryCatch(rf_gcomp_effects(data[boot_idx[[b]], ], outcome, seed = seed + b),
                        error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(est)))
  }
  se <- apply(bm, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    outcome  = outcome_label,
    effect   = c("TE", "PNDE", "TNDE", "PNIE", "TNIE"),
    estimate = as.numeric(est),
    ci_lower = apply(bm, 2, quantile, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_upper = apply(bm, 2, quantile, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    pvalue   = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se)),
    row.names = NULL, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

results_biden_w <- weighted_mediation(df_med, "voted_biden_2020", "Voted Biden")
results_trump_w <- weighted_mediation(df_med, "voted_trump_2020", "Voted Trump")

all_results_w <- bind_rows(results_biden_w, results_trump_w) %>%
  mutate(
    effect_category = case_when(
      effect == "TE"                ~ "Total Effect",
      effect %in% c("PNDE", "TNDE") ~ "Natural Direct Effect",
      effect %in% c("PNIE", "TNIE") ~ "Natural Indirect Effect"
    ),
    significant = pvalue < 0.05
  )

all_results_w %>%
  mutate(CI = sprintf("(%.4f, %.4f)", ci_lower, ci_upper),
         estimate = round(estimate, 4), pvalue = round(pvalue, 4),
         sig = ifelse(significant, "*", "")) %>%
  dplyr::select(outcome, effect, estimate, CI, pvalue, sig)
```

```{r weighted-evalues}
evalue_rd <- function(est, p0) {
  rr <- {
    p1 <- pmin(pmax(p0 + est, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
    r  <- p1 / p0
    ifelse(r < 1, 1 / r, r)
  }
  rr <- pmax(rr, 1)
  rr + sqrt(rr * (rr - 1))
}

w0 <- df_med$untrustworthy_flag == 0
p0 <- c("Voted Biden" = weighted.mean(df_med$voted_biden_2020[w0], df_med$survey_weight[w0]),
        "Voted Trump" = weighted.mean(df_med$voted_trump_2020[w0], df_med$survey_weight[w0]))

bind_rows(results_biden_w, results_trump_w) %>%
  mutate(
    p0         = p0[outcome],
    ci_bound   = ifelse(estimate < 0, ci_upper, ci_lower),
    E_value    = round(evalue_rd(estimate, p0), 3),
    E_value_CI = round(ifelse(abs(ci_bound) > 1e-4, evalue_rd(ci_bound, p0), 1), 3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(outcome, effect, estimate, E_value, E_value_CI)
```
